text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert — api-embeddings average p95 latency 2.6s (>2.0s SLO) for last 5m. Triggered auto-fallback to fallback-small-embed. Pager: paging@redwood.example (link: https://ops.example/incident/2723456789)

Elaine: seeing it, jumping on bridge. any affected customers reported?

Samir: on call, looking at the dashboard — throughput steady but p95 spikes align with kv-evict spikes across shard-3. suspect prefix/KV cache eviction cascade.

Maria: I can confirm a single enterprise tenant (acme-inc) has a spike in errors where the client is retrying and hitting fallback models. they reported embedding quality drop. posting sample trace: `trace-id=ab12cd34`

Elaine: thanks. Samir, can you dump pod logs for shard-3 and kvcache? try `kubectl logs -l shard=3 -c runtime --since=10m`

Samir: running. quick paste of the last 60s:```
E 15:12:03 kvcache: eviction pressure triggered, freeing 18MB
W 15:12:04 runtime: cache-miss upstream fetch 21ms
E 15:12:04 runtime: kv-append failure: deadline exceeded
E 15:12:05 router: fallback_to_model=fallback-small-embed triggered for route=/v1/embeddings
```

Ryan (DevEx): tag @Elaine @Samir — looks like the eviction was unusually aggressive due to a new prewarm job that ran for shard-3 at 15:09. That job had a `--force-warm` flag and touched all keys, causing churn.

Elaine: can we mitigate quickly? suggested immediate actions: 1) disable prewarm for shard-3, 2) bump KV GC thresholds, 3) temporarily increase concurrency limit for embeddings route to smooth retries.

Ops Lead: doing 1 now — disabling prewarm job (job id prewarm-2026-03-15T15:09). Confirmed cancellation.

Samir: 2) bumping kv eviction threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75 on shard-3 via: `curl -XPOST http://kv-admin/shard/3/threshold -d '{"evict_frac":0.75}'` — applied.

Maria: 3) increased route concurrency on edge: `edgectl set-route /v1/embeddings --concurrency 120` — applied, monitoring.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: mitigation actions applied: prewarm cancelled, kv threshold updated, route concurrency increased. Observed p95 reducing to ~1.3s after 90s.

Elaine: good. customer impact: acme-inc embedding quality degraded for ~6 minutes, some retry loops. we should notify CS and schedule postmortem.

Maria: notifying CS now — pinged @cs-acme on Slack and opened a support case. they asked for a timeline and root cause once we have it.

Samir: temporary mitigations look stable. collectors show reduced evictions and decreased fallback counts. I'd like to schedule a postmortem to cover: prewarm job behavior, kv eviction heuristics, and fallback routing thresholds.

Elaine: agree. propose a 1-hour postmortem sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. agenda: timeline, root cause hypothesis, action items + owners, runbook updates.

Ryan (DevEx): I'll own runbook edit for prewarm jobs so future prewarm runs don't touch hot shards concurrently. Proposed docs change snippet:```
# prewarm-run checklist
- verify target shards list
- run with `--stagger 30s` when targeting >1 shard
- abort on eviction-rate > 0.2
```

Elaine: assignable action items — please confirm owners and ETA in thread: 1) Root cause write-up (Samir) ETA: EOD tomorrow. 2) Runbook change (Ryan) ETA: 48h. 3) KV tuning permanent threshold review (Ops Lead) ETA: 72h. 4) Customer follow-up note (Maria/CS) ETA: 4h.

Samir: ack — will post detailed root-cause and traces by EOD tomorrow.

Ops Lead: ack — will run load tests with new thresholds and propose permanent values within 72h.

Maria: ack — cs follow-up sent. will attach trace-id and mitigation timeline.

Elaine: scheduling: postmortem invite sent to incident stakeholders + infra + cs + devex for tomorrow 09:30 PT. meeting link in case notes.

incident-bot: :calendar: Postmortem created: https://ops.example/postmortem/2723456789 — reminder set for attendees 30m before meeting.

Elaine: final immediate note — we should add automated guardrail to prewarm pipeline to prevent `--force-warm` on multiple shards and to gate based on current eviction rate. putting that into the runbook item list.

Ryan (DevEx): adding `prewarm:guardrail` checklist to runbook PR draft now. will reference the snippet above and include a rollout and canary plan.

Samir: closing this pager. will monitor for 2 hours and report back.

incident-bot: :lock: Pager closed by Samir. Duration: 00:12:40.

Elaine: thanks all — good mitigation and customer comms. we'll capture lessons in the postmortem and track action items in the infra backlog.

Samir: leaving notes in the incident channel and linking traces.

Maria: adding CS case updates and marking affected orders in the support dashboard.

Ryan (DevEx): PR draft for runbook changes available at https://git.example/repo/runbooks/pull/423 — will iterate after postmortem.

Ops Lead: creating infra backlog ticket: INFRA-9876 (kv-eviction-thresholds + prewarm guardrails).

Elaine: perfect. set follow-ups and we'll close after action items are done. :thumbsup:
